metadata.description: Claude Code mods for running several named agents side by side: see each session's name and ID, and link the agents on one repository into a team that can message each other.

plugins.name: session-label
plugins.description: Keeps your session's /rename name and full session ID pinned above the prompt, so you always know which session you're in.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Links the named Claude Code sessions working in the same git repository into a team: each teammate welcomes a newcomer with a brief of its work, /team shows who's doing what, and /tell messages a teammate.
